authority.coverageRule: Exactly one authority-backed coverage row is required for every persistent-consequence and temporary-cleanup domain. Facts cannot appear under not-applicable coverage and every fact authority must be one exact authority declared by that domain.
forbiddenDerivations: effect tags without an owning provider
document copies used as mechanics authority

persistentConsequences.rule: Every row stores only one bounded before/after value, exact source authority, stable field identity, participant scope when applicable, and one source-owned behavior. HP and accepted-event evidence cannot be silently transformed at settlement.

temporaryCleanup.rule: Temporary rows name exact source identities and affected current participants. Reset, expiration, transformation, or preservation is declarative preview evidence; P8-079 source-owned reducers perform cleanup.

boundedDecisions.authority: Every option names the exact current fact authority.
boundedDecisions.identity: SHA-256 over version, settlement identity, scope, and stable source-fact identity.
boundedDecisions.acceptedRule: An accepted option is retained only while subject, audience, ordered options, and exact authority remain unchanged. It cannot be rewritten by refresh.

refreshAndAudit.entryIdentity: SHA-256 over version, settlement identity, persistent-or-temporary scope, and stable source-fact identity
refreshAndAudit.ordering: stable entry and decision identity order
refreshAndAudit.appliedEvidence: An applied entry or linked receipt cannot be rewritten. An applied source fact cannot disappear from a complete refresh.
refreshAndAudit.acceptedDecision: An accepted snapshot decision cannot disappear or change options through refresh.
refreshAndAudit.foreignEntry: A consequence or cleanup row not owned by this versioned builder is rejected instead of silently replaced.
refreshAndAudit.terminalRule: Snapshots cannot be rebuilt after status enters committing, completed, or cancelled.

snapshotDoesNotOwn: HP, Injury, condition, capture, inventory, equipment, objective, clock, phase, effect, resource, or event mechanics
terminal commit, rollback, history, realtime, or public projection

privacy.projectionRule: Later projections resolve safe labels and behavior summaries from current authorized sources; they never expose raw snapshot authority.
